DOTA_Tooltip_ability_fountain_buyback_De: Brings your hero back at the fountain right away, for gold.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_fountain_glyph_Desc: Your buildings turn invulnerable for 7 seconds and your lane creeps for 3. Towers past tier 1 hit 5 extra targets meanwhile.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_radar_Description: Watches a 900 radius spot for 8 seconds and tells whether enemy heroes are inside.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_buyback_gold_penal: Gold income is 60% lower for a while afterwards.
dvw_scan_target: Click the ground to scan there. Right-click cancels.
